mapper.sql: project_id as projectId, kind, content, source_refs as sourceRefs, updated_at as updatedAt, updated_by as updatedBy
mapper.select: select from builder.adk_builder_business_document where project_id = #{projectId} order by kind
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_business_document (project_id, kind, content, source_refs, updated_at, updated_by) values (#{projectId}, #{kind}, #{content}, #{sourceRefs, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) on conflict (project_id, kind) do update set content = excluded.content, source_refs = excluded.source_refs, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by
